definitions.explanation: The act of loading goods or cargo onto a vehicle, ship, or container.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The loading of the luggage is finished.

examples.japanese: {積|つ}み{込|こ}み⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The loading work is done in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{積|つ}み{込|こ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二時間|にじかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Loading onto the truck took two hours.

notes:
Noun form of the verb ⟦{積|つ}み{込|こ}む→積み込む：16751_tsumikomu⟧ (to load). Refers to the act or process of loading cargo onto vehicles, ships, or containers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}み⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: loading work/operation
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}み⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧: loading complete
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}み⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: start of loading
- {積|つ}み{込|こ}み⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: loading area

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{積|つ}み{下|お}ろし→積み下ろし：09801_tsumioroshi⟧: unloading

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{積|つ}み{込|こ}む→積み込む：16751_tsumikomu⟧: to load (verb form)
- ⟦{荷積|にづ}み→荷積み：24584_nizumi⟧: loading cargo
- ⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧: shipping, dispatching

REGISTER:
Used in logistics, transportation, and warehouse contexts.
